en: you? Yeah, I'm sorry. Are you planning
zh: 你？是的，我很抱歉。你打算一直這樣

en: to keep this up until you get yourself killed? I think it's time.
zh: 你打算一直這樣下去直到把自己害死嗎？我覺得是時候了。

notes.zh: keep up：跟上腳步／跟上進度
notes.example: Walk a little slower—I can barely keep up!

en: Do you want to know why most people live and die without accomplishing a single damn thing? It's because THEY'VE LOST
zh: 你想知道為什麼大多數人活著死了卻一事無成嗎？這是因為他們失去了
一事無成嗎？這是因為他們失去了想像力。

en: THEY'LL COMPLACENTLY WASTE THEIR ENTIRE LIVES UNASHAMED OF THE FACT THAT ALL THEY'LL EVER ADD TO THE WORLD IS
zh: 想像力。他們會安於現狀，虛度光陰，絲毫不會為自己一生只會為世界帶來垃圾的事實感到羞恥。

en: SUCH PEOPLE ARE LITTLE MORE than cattle.
zh: 為世界帶來垃圾的事實感到羞恥。這樣的人簡直就像牲畜一樣。
這樣的人簡直就像牲畜一樣。他們根本無法理解偉大。

en: Why should anyone have to be special?
zh: 他們根本無法理解偉大。為什麼有人一定要特殊？

en: That just isn't the way I like to look at things.
zh: 我並不喜歡用那種方式

en: And when it comes to my child, I don't care if he grows up to be great.
zh: 看待事物。至於我的孩子，我並不在意他長大後是否會成就一番偉業。

en: My son doesn't have to be better than anyone.
zh: 我的兒子不必比任何人優秀。

notes.zh: have better things to do：有更要緊的事要做
notes.example: I didn't want to bother you—you have better things to do.

en: After all, just look at him. He's so cute.
I think Eren's special enough already.
zh: 我覺得艾倫已經夠特別了。

en: For no other reason than that he was born into this world.
zh: 我覺得艾倫已經夠特別了。他來到這個世界，別無其他原因。
